steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan on medium heat and add the cumin. Let it sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the garlic, green chilli and hing and fry for about a minute, until the garlic turns light brown.
Add the onion and cook for about 3 minutes, until soft and see-through.
Add the potato, turmeric, coriander powder, chilli powder, salt and about a spoon of water a person. Stir well.
Cover and cook on medium-low for 7 to 10 minutes, stirring every couple of minutes, until a knife goes easily into the potato.
Turn the heat to medium-high and add the spinach a handful at a time, stirring until each lot wilts.
Cook uncovered for 3 to 4 minutes more, stirring, until no water is left in the pan.
Turn off the heat, stir in the garam masala, squeeze over the lemon and serve with roti.
note: Both sources make a dry stir-fry, not the spinach gravy the old recipe was based on, so besan, tomato, ginger, ghee and bay leaf are gone and lemon is added. Spinach goes up from 50 g to 80 g, which is what both use.
